str1.title: Project Introduction
str1.desc: I Explore Your Expectations And The Ideas(If Any) You Have. Assist You To Make A Clean Brief, Then Dig Deeper To Identify The Achievable Best Solution. Email Is The Preferred Communication Method At This Stage. When You Decide To Work With Us, We Get Together To Create A Detailed Brief With Assumptions And Constraints.

str2.title: Research & Concept
str2.desc: The Objective Of This Stage Is To Define The Project Scope, Technical Requirements, And Milestones. Your Project Starts To Get A Face Based On Your Information. i Will Create The Visual/S And Design Guidelines For Your Approval. and Start Working On Approved Visual/S And Ensure It Looks As Expected. Based On Your Review Feedback.

str3.title: Project Termination
str3.desc: I Will Work Through The Checklist Before It Goes Live. After Making It Live, We Will Be There For Any Urgent Bug Fixes. We Will Share Documentation, Including Video Instructions So That You Can Reference Them For Any Updates/Fixes. I’ll Be Here For Any Help And Advice.

service1.title: Always On Time
service1.desc: I will delivery your project on time so that you can start your business with your previous plan.

service2.title: Professional Work
service2.desc: I am a Professional Web Designer and Developer. So, I always here to design your website professionally.

service3.title: 24/7 Availability
service3.desc: I am here to help you always. If you are facing any kind of problem than you can contact me 24/7.

hardWorking.title: Hard Working
hardWorking.desc: I am a hard working person who always works hard for his clients. So, there is no way to delay.

security.title: High Security
security.desc: Security is one of the most important issue for a website. So, I always work carefully to protect your website properly.

satisfaction.title: 100% Satisfaction
satisfaction.desc: I always take corrections from clients before submitting project and work as a way of the most satisfaction.

afterSupport.title: After Selling Support
afterSupport.desc: I will provide after selling support. The support will not be paid but if there is any big issue you may charge for solution.

speed.title: Speed Optimization
